title: Amplification of randomized decision probability
statement: Let $\varepsilon,\eta\in\mathbb{Q}$, with $0\le\varepsilon$, and let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $2(1-4\varepsilon^2)^n\le\eta$. For every time bound $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, each language decidable in time bounded by a constant multiple of $T$ with acceptance probability at least $\tfrac12+\varepsilon$ is also decidable in time bounded by a constant multiple of $T$ with acceptance probability at least $1-\eta$.
